## Problem

Describe the problem or opportunity this design addresses. Why is this needed now?

## Proposed Approach

Describe the proposed solution in detail. Include:
- Architecture changes
- New contracts or contract modifications
- Data structures
- API changes
- User flow changes

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches were considered? Why were they rejected?

## Open Questions

What remains uncertain or needs discussion before implementation?

## Impact on Existing Behavior

What does this change about existing contract behavior? Consider:
- Breaking changes to APIs
- Migration requirements
- Backward compatibility
- Security implications
